article: For each question, write the correct answer. Moving house Hi Alex,  How are you? This week's been a very busy one for me - I finally moved house (27)…………… I didn't realize until I started to pack a few days ago that I had so much stuff. I really think moving house is one of the (28)…………… stressful things I've ever done! I was sad to leave my old house - after (29)……………, I lived there my whole life so I have lots of good memories.  Anyway, I'm looking (30)…………… to living in this new house. It's not as big as the old one, but (31)…………… least it's got a great garden. I'm planning to have a small party on Saturday night. Are you free then? Why don't you come along (32)…………… you can make it. Let me know.  All the best, Sam

explanations.27:
原因：连接 “moved house” 和 “didn't realize” 两个并列动作，表顺承关系。
语法点：并列连词 and 连接两个分句，无转折或因果，类似如 “I ate breakfast and went to school.”
explanations.28:
原因：“one of the most stressful things” 为最高级结构，“最…… 之一”。
语法点：one of + the + 最高级 + 复数名词，如 “one of the most beautiful cities”。
explanations.29:
原因：“after all” 固定短语，表 “毕竟”，解释留恋老房子的原因。
词汇点：after all 用于强调原因，类似如 “After all, he is just a child.”
explanations.30:
原因：“look forward to” 固定搭配，表 “期待”。
语法点：to 为介词，后接动名词，如 “look forward to seeing you”。
explanations.31:
原因：“at least” 固定短语，表 “至少”，强调新屋优点。
词汇点：at least 用于缓和语气，如 “At least you tried your best.”
explanations.32:
原因：条件句引导词，“如果能来就来吧”。
语法点：if 引导条件状语从句，如 “If it rains, we will stay inside.”
